provenance: Separate-agent adversarial review in the same model/team lineage. Not independent external review.
review_kind: raw proof derivation, quantifier, semantic dictionary and vacuity audit

validation.scope: Fresh file acceptance only; integrated axiom audit and kernel replay remain parent responsibilities.

claim: For any finite active grammar subset with positive evidence, full versus zero-extended active posterior TV equals omitted posterior mass, every common predictive event differs by at most this mass, and an omitted-evidence bound gives b/(ZA+b). Along an increasing exhaustive sequence, actual posterior TV tends to zero.
assumptions: Active set A is finite with ZA>0; hence full evidence Z>=ZA>0.
Omitted evidence is bounded by b; monotone exhaustive active sets for convergence.
dependency_graph: On A, q=w/ZA >= p=w/Z; off A q=0.
Pointwise absolute difference is p+q-2*retained_p; summing gives 2-2*ZA/Z.
For d=p-q with sum zero, event weighting in [0,1] lies between negative and positive variation totals.
Actual omitted evidence is Z-ZA and b>=Z-ZA>=0; cross multiplication yields (Z-ZA)/Z<=b/(ZA+b).
Monotone exhaustive finite sets are cofinal; composing HasSum with cofinality gives ZA_n -> Z.
Positive Z implies eventually positive ZA_n, so the actual TV error is eventually equal to 1-ZA_n/Z and tends to zero.

obligation_matrix.obligation: Summability is explicit wherever infinite-sum subtraction or monotone comparison is used.
All-event family bound quantifies over arbitrary event indices, so it covers every measurable event of any supplied common kernel.
Early zero-evidence stages do not invalidate convergence; eventual positivity is proved separately.
The source proves actual TV convergence rather than merely convergence of a surrogate tail scalar.
Empty active sets are excluded exactly by ZA>0; zero omitted bound gives exact agreement.

residual_limits: No claim that the true mechanism belongs to the enumerated grammar.
Predictive kernel measure construction is external input; the proof uses its event probabilities and proves their uniform bound.
The bound b requires actual omitted evidence control; likelihood densities are not assumed <=1.
strongest_safe_statement: For any finite active grammar subset with positive evidence, full versus zero-extended active posterior TV equals omitted posterior mass, every common predictive event differs by at most this mass, and an omitted-evidence bound gives b/(ZA+b). Along an increasing exhaustive sequence, actual posterior TV tends to zero.
